senses.gloss:
पृक्का पृक्का, f. a species of leguminous
plant, Trigonella Corniculata; [cf. स्पृक्का.]
पृक्त पृक्त, पृक्ति. See under rt. 1. पृच्.

पृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed, mingled, combined;
brought into contact, touched, united, being in com-
bination with, touching [cf. मयूख-प्˚]; filled,
full (e. g. घृत-पृक्त, full of ghee); (अम्), n.
possessions, property, wealth (in these senses a wrong
reading for पृक्थ, q. v.).

पृक्थ पृक्थ, अम्, n. possession, property,
wealth; [cf. रिक्थ.]

पृक्ष् पृक्ष्, f. (the nom. sing. does not
[]
occur; perhaps connected with rt. 1. पृच्), Ved.
refreshment, food, nourishment, satiation.
—पृक्षु-
धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (according to Sāy.) = पशु-
पुरोडाशादिषु दाह-मध्ये धीयमानः, being
placed in the midst of the burnt offerings of animals,
ghee, &c., or = प्र-क्षोध्यः. = प्रकर्षेण
बुभुक्षितः; (perhaps a corruption for प्र-
क्षुध, ‘hungry, eager.’)

पृक्ष पृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fleet, swift
(? said of a horse); having food, (Sāy.) = घासाद्य्-
अन्न-वत्, possessing grass and other food; (अस्),
m. a swift horse, courser (an epithet especially of
the horses of the Aśvins, Agni, and Indra); N. of a
man; a battle.
—पृक्ष-प्रयज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved.
(perhaps) hastening with swift horses; (Sāy.) in
which oblations of food begin to be offered (said of
the morning).
—पृक्ष-याम, अस्, आ, अम्, driving
swift horses; (Sāy.) = अन्नानां नियमनं यस्-
मिन्, in which there is the offering of food; (अस्),
m. a proper N. (?).
